$comment: Yeelight messages worked out by hand from the Yeelight WiFi Light Inter-Operation Specification, not by running the plugin. Commands are {"id":N,"method":...,"params":[...]} + \r\n; *_noid entries are the same lines with "id":N, removed (ids count up from 1 per session: get_prop 1, set_music 2, then the music stream). Colours: the brightest channel becomes 255 and set_bright = round(max * 100 / 255), at least 1; black = set_power off. #FF0000 -> rgb 0xFF0000 = 16711680, bright 100. #000080 -> rgb 0x0000FF = 255, bright round(50.2) = 50. #123456: max 0x56 = 86, k = 255/86: r 18k = 53.37 -> 53, g 52k = 154.19 -> 154, b 255; rgb = 53*65536 + 154*256 + 255 = 3513087; bright round(33.73) = 34. {PORT} is the port listen() returned.
